fato_historico: 1989: The 6.9 Mw Loma Prieta earthquake shakes the San Francisco Bay Area and the Central Coast, killing 63.
energia_do_dia: Today brings an invitation to recognize that even when the earth shifts beneath our feet, our internal resilience remains unshaken. Like the deep roots of a mountain, you may find that your stability is a source of inspiration for others. Consider this a time to fortify your spirit, rebuilding with grace after any sudden tremors in your routine.
frase_do_dia: Strong foundations are built through patience and a heart that stays grounded in truth.
significado_numero: A reminder of the strength found within community and shared support systems.
conselho: Trust your inner wisdom and take small, steady steps toward your long-term goals today.
